items.summary: This is a follow-up to my post from yesterday (17 -> 25-29 t/s with the expert cache PR). Same box: 2x RTX 3090 on PCIe 3.0, dual Xeon E5-2696 v4, 188 GB DDR4-2133 LRDIMM, llama.cpp, full 261k context, f16 KV, all 48 expert layers in host RAM, everything else on the GPUs. Since then I switched quants, stacked MTP on top of the cache, fixed the load time, found a bug in the cache PR and found out my RAM was thermal throttling (Now i gotta buy an additional case fan lol).
